LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_SmallWorm1.label: Small sandworm reinforcement I
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_SmallWorm1.description: When the challenge begins, the sand leviathan calls in one additional small sandworm.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_SmallWorm2.label: Small sandworm reinforcement II
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_SmallWorm2.description: Based on the previous reinforcement, one more small sandworm is called in.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_SmallWorm3.label: Small sandworm ferocity III
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_SmallWorm3.description: All small sandworms added by risk tags gain head instant-kill capability and 30% more hit points.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_ChargeFrenzy1.label: Sandworm frenzy I
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_ChargeFrenzy1.description: The sand leviathan's charge cooldown is reduced by 20%, letting it enter its next frenzied pursuit sooner.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_ChargeFrenzy2.label: Sandworm frenzy II
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_ChargeFrenzy2.description: The sand leviathan's charge cooldown is reduced by 40%, making frenzied pursuits pressure the battlefield more often.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_ChargeFrenzy3.label: Sandworm frenzy III
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_ChargeFrenzy3.description: The sand leviathan's charge cooldown is reduced by 60%, allowing rapid repeated frenzied pursuits.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_DamageCap1.label: Heavy carapace I
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_DamageCap1.description: The sand leviathan cannot take more than 60 damage from a single hit.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_DamageCap2.label: Heavy carapace II
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_DamageCap2.description: The sand leviathan cannot take more than 40 damage from a single hit.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_DamageCap3.label: Heavy carapace III
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_DamageCap3.description: The sand leviathan cannot take more than 20 damage from a single hit.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_PawnRange1.label: Suppressed firing line I
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_PawnRange1.description: Participating pawns' ranged weapon range is reduced by 10%.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_PawnRange2.label: Suppressed firing line II
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_PawnRange2.description: Participating pawns' ranged weapon range is reduced by 30%.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_PawnRange3.label: Suppressed firing line III
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_PawnRange3.description: Participating pawns' ranged weapon range is reduced by 50%.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_PawnMove1.label: Deep sand drag I
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_PawnMove1.description: Participating pawns' movement speed is reduced by 20%.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_PawnMove2.label: Deep sand drag II
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_PawnMove2.description: Participating pawns' movement speed is reduced by 40%.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_PawnMove3.label: Deep sand drag III
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_PawnMove3.description: Participating pawns' movement speed is reduced by 60%.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_ShockwaveAttack1.label: Seismic shock I
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_ShockwaveAttack1.descripti: The sand leviathan gains a periodic full-map radial shockwave. Before release, stone walls rise as cover; uncovered pawns take 100 blunt damage.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_ShockwaveAttack2.label: Seismic resonance II
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_ShockwaveAttack2.descripti: The seismic shock charges faster and its danger lanes widen. Shockwave cooldown is reduced by 25%, and lane width increases by 15%.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_ShockwaveAttack3.label: Seismic fission III
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_ShockwaveAttack3.descripti: The underground resonance becomes unstable. Shockwave cooldown is reduced by 45%, lane width increases by 30%, and shockwave damage increases by 25%.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_SandBlind1.label: Sand veil interference I
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_SandBlind1.description: Dense sand inside the Syndicate space disrupts aiming. Participating pawns have 10% lower shooting accuracy and 10% longer aiming time.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_SandBlind2.label: Sand veil interference II
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_SandBlind2.description: The sand veil suppresses ranged fire even harder. Participating pawns have 22% lower shooting accuracy and 25% longer aiming time.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_ResonancePressure1.label: Resonance countdown I
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_ResonancePressure1.descrip: The longer the fight drags on, the more easily underground echoes attract reinforcements. 4800 ticks after the leviathan appears, one small sandworm arrives every 3600 ticks, up to 3 times.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_ResonancePressure2.label: Resonance countdown II
LanguageData.SandWorm_Risk_ResonancePressure2.descrip: The underground resonance destabilizes sooner. 3600 ticks after the leviathan appears, one small sandworm arrives every 2400 ticks, up to 5 times; if seismic shock is enabled, the next shockwave cooldown is compressed.
